Activating Everyone’s Neural Network

Every person here sits at the center of their own neural network, the clients, contacts, and past relationships only they can reach. The first two pieces below let them switch that network on with almost no effort. We do the writing and the design. Employees just post, sign, and send. Here’s the thinking behind each piece and a rough look at what it becomes.

Toolkit Piece 01

Ready-Made Post Content

The Idea

We write it once. Everyone can post it.

Our team writes the post and runs it across all of the Office Furniture Plus social properties. Then we hand employees a ready-to-go version they can drop straight onto their own LinkedIn.

Why it works. A post from a real person lands differently than one from a brand page. Same message, many more voices, and no one has to figure out what to say.

Springbolt Handles This

We write it, design it, and schedule it.

We build the email templates, add your artwork and copy, then schedule the sends. All you do is review, approve, and we handle the rest.

Why it works. A coordinated email cadence is the fastest way to fill seats. We manage the timing, the copy, the design, and the technical side so nothing falls through the cracks.

Toolkit Piece 02

Signature Graphics

The Idea

Every email becomes an invite.

A branded graphic and link that employees drop into their email signature. From that point on, every message they already send is quietly promoting the next webinar or offer.

Why it works. No new behavior required. People email all day. The signature does the reaching out for them.

Toolkit Piece 03

Cold Email Sequence

The Idea

A three-email sequence that fills seats.

A short, human-written cold sequence sent through Apollo to our target titles, facilities managers, office managers, preconstruction and CRE contacts. Each email is a light touch built around one thing, getting them to the webinar.

Why it works. One cold email rarely converts. A sequence does. Email one opens with a real problem, email two adds proof, email three creates urgency before the doors close.

Toolkit Piece 04

Three-Touch Cadence Email Set

The Idea

Announce it. Remind. Nudge.

A simple set of three emails timed around each session. One to announce it, one the day before, and one the morning of. Written and ready, so nothing falls through the cracks.

Why it works. Most sign-ups come from the reminder, not the announcement. Three light touches beat one big send every time.
